name: Cross-cutting EPC incoherence across all six dimensions

documents.title: EPC-SYN-AIR-14 Contract
documents.synthetic_text: EPC lump sum, FIDIC Silver 2017. Hard delivery 2028-06-30. Scope per Annex II. Warranty 24 months. LDs 0.15%/day capped 10%. IEC 61850 MMS for substations. Class A BMS integration.

documents.title: EPC-SYN-AIR-14 Schedule
documents.synthetic_text: Forecast completion 2028-09-30. Critical path through terminal roof. BMS commissioning omitted. No FAT for substation protection relays despite 2-week window reserved in early 2028 activities.

documents.title: EPC-SYN-AIR-14 Budget
documents.synthetic_text: EPC value 480,000,000 EUR. Contingency 2% (below industry norm 5%). No explicit allocation for BMS. LD provision 0 EUR. Substation 22,000,000 EUR.

documents.title: EPC-SYN-AIR-14 Technical Specifications
documents.synthetic_text: Substation protection must support IEC 61850 edition 2.1 GOOSE and MMS. BMS shall comply with ASHRAE Guideline 36. Fire detection EN 54-13 certified. Acceptance via 30-day operational test.

documents.title: EPC-SYN-AIR-14 Key Drawings
documents.synthetic_text: Drawing AR-200 shows two substations only; contract references three. Drawing ME-310 omits BMS riser. Structural drawings STR-100 reference 2022 Eurocode annex while contract cites 2024 annex.

expected_issues.description_contains: LD cap and warranty interact with a forecast delay that exceeds the capped amount
No FAT scheduled for substation protection relays despite specification requirement
Third substation in contract is missing from drawings and schedule
Forecast completion is 3 months past the hard delivery date
Contingency below industry norm and no LD provision
Drawings reference Eurocode 2022 annex while contract requires 2024 annex

expected_score_range.reasoning: Expert all-dimension bundle has four high issues and two medium issues, so score should be very low but non-null.
